show_us.title: At CodeNation Studio, we build software with purpose, people, and quality, not just code.

purpose.title: Technology rooted locally, built for global impact
purpose.description:
We’re proudly from Guadalajara, Jalisco — Mexico’s tech capital.

We think big: our products and partnerships span borders. We collaborate with local universities to discover emerging talent, train from the ground up, and bridge the gap between academia and industry.

Many of our engineers started as interns. Today, they lead technical projects. Here, you don’t just work. You grow.

solutions.title: What drives us
solutions.description:
We don’t build software just to make it run. We build it for what it makes possible:

 • Watching an MVP we built help a startup secure its first funding round.

 • Receiving a message that says: “This transformed my business.”

 • Seeing a student from a partner university grow into a full-stack engineer on our team.

 • Knowing the solutions we design are used—and loved—by real people, every day.

contact.title: Have an idea worth building?
contact.description: We partner with founders and teams who care about doing things right. From validating an MVP to developing complex systems, we bring solid engineering and strategic thinking. We focus on building solutions that are reliable, scalable, and thoughtfully designed. Tell us what you're working on.

story.title: “More than clients, we look for expedition partners”
story.description: Software is just the vehicle. What matters is who’s on the other side: Do you have an idea that challenges the status quo? We bring rigorous engineering, homegrown talent, and years of experience building systems. If your mission demands more than a vendor… you’re in the right place.

trophy_shelf.count: More than trophies: validation of impact
trophy_shelf.title: Awards celebrate. Accelerators test. We create value — together.
trophy_shelf.description: Our journey has been validated by high-impact programs like Endeavor, EmpreLatam, Reto Zapopan, and Codelaunch
